scene.speaker: maya
scene.bubble: Oliver fell asleep in the library because he practised all night. He was SO tired that he snored on the dictionary!
scene.intro: Oliver fell asleep in the library because he practised until two in the morning. He was tired, so he used a dictionary as a pillow. Maya was hungry, so she ate his sandwich — because he wasn't looking. The class was bored, so the teacher changed the plan. Everyone was excited, because tomorrow is the trip. Say WHY things happen with because, and WHAT happens with so!

data.script: Maya: Let me tell everyone what happened, Oliver! … Maya: Oliver practised his guitar until three in the morning. … Maya: So the next day he was very, very tired. … Maya: He fell asleep in the library, on top of a huge dictionary! … Oliver: Because the dictionary was soft! Well… no, it wasn't. … Maya: He snored so loudly that the librarian thought it was thunder. … Maya: So now there's a new rule in the library: no sleeping on the dictionaries! … Oliver: And I have a new rule too: practise until ten o'clock, then sleep!

data.text: Chain story: Student A starts "I was hungry, so…". Student B continues the result and adds a new cause: "…so I opened the fridge, but it was empty, so…". Keep the chain going for 6 turns!

data.script: Look at the picture. Listen and write the names. There is one example. … Diego: Who is that in the picnic garden? The girl in the green shirt with a magnifying glass. … Maya: That is Maya. Maya is looking at something very small. … Diego: And who is the boy with red hair and a yellow shirt? … Maya: That is Oliver. Look, Oliver is singing. … Diego: And who is the boy with short fair hair and a rucksack? … Maya: That is Samu. Look, Samu is waving. … Diego: And who is the boy with curly brown hair and a green shirt? … Maya: That is Bruno. Look, Bruno is running after the ball. … Diego: And who is the girl with long straight black hair and an orange shirt? … Maya: That is Aiko. Look, Aiko is reading a book.
